title: "Exploration des données DHS Niger 2012"
output: html_notebook

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(sf)
  library(haven)
  library(survey)
})
```

## Charger les données brutes

```{r}
dhs <- haven::read_dta("data/raw/NIHR61FL.DTA")
gps <- sf::st_read("data/raw/NIGE61FL.shp", quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
cat("Nombre de ménages dans le DHS :", nrow(dhs), "\n")
cat("Nombre de clusters GPS :", nrow(gps), "\n")
cat("Période de l'enquête :",
    min(dhs$hv007, na.rm = TRUE), "-",
    max(dhs$hv007, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

---

## Distribution de l'indice de richesse

```{r wealth-hist}
ggplot(dhs, aes(x = hv271)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#1f77b4", alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title    = "Distribution de l'indice de richesse (HV271)",
    subtitle = "10 750 ménages enquêtés au Niger en 2012",
    x = "Indice de richesse (score continu)", y = "Nombre de ménages"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
summary(dhs$hv271)
```

---

## Richesse par région

```{r wealth-region}
dhs <- dhs %>%
  mutate(region_label = as_factor(hv024))

ggplot(dhs, aes(x = region_label, y = hv271, fill = region_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title    = "Distribution de la richesse par région",
    subtitle = "DHS Niger 2012",
    x = "Région", y = "Indice de richesse"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## Carte des 476 clusters DHS

```{r cluster-map, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = gps, aes(color = URBAN_RURA), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("R" = "#2ca02c", "U" = "#d62728"),
    labels = c("R" = "Rural", "U" = "Urbain"),
    name   = "Milieu"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Les 476 clusters DHS du Niger (2012)",
    subtitle = "Rouge = urbain, vert = rural",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

### Carte des régions (Admin 1)

```{r admin1-map, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
admin1 <- sf::st_read("data/raw/ner_admin1.shp", quiet = TRUE)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = admin1, fill = "#f0f0f0", color = "#333333", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf_text(data = admin1, aes(label = adm1_name),
               size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_sf(data = gps, color = "#1f77b4", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Régions du Niger (Admin 1) et clusters DHS",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Carte des départements (Admin 2)

```{r admin2-map, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
admin2 <- sf::st_read("data/raw/ner_admin2.shp", quiet = TRUE)

ggplot() +
```

## Effectifs : combien de clusters par département ?

```{r clusters-per-dept}
cluster_coords <- gps %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.integer(DHSCLUST)) %>%
  select(cluster, LATNUM, LONGNUM)

cluster_coords_sf <- st_as_sf(
  cluster_coords,
  coords = c("LONGNUM", "LATNUM"),
  crs = 4326, remove = FALSE
)

cluster_dept <- st_join(cluster_coords_sf, admin2["adm2_name"]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Compter par département
effectifs <- cluster_dept %>%
  group_by(adm2_name = adm2_name) %>%
  summarise(n_clusters = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_clusters))

cat("Résumé : clusters par département\n")
summary(effectifs$n_clusters)
cat("\nDépartements avec le plus de clusters :\n")
print(head(effectifs, 10))
cat("\nDépartements avec le moins de clusters :\n")
print(tail(effectifs, 10))
```

```{r clusters-per-dept-hist}
ggplot(effectifs, aes(x = n_clusters)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "#ff7f0e", alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title    = "Distribution : nombre de clusters par département",
    subtitle = paste0("Médiane = ", median(effectifs$n_clusters),
                      ", min = ", min(effectifs$n_clusters),
                      ", max = ", max(effectifs$n_clusters)),
    x = "Nombre de clusters", y = "Nombre de départements"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Richesse moyenne par région (pondérée)

```{r direct-by-region}
design <- svydesign(ids = ~hv001, weights = ~hv005, data = dhs, nest = TRUE)
direct_reg <- svyby(~hv271, ~region_label, design, svymean) %>%
  rename(region = region_label, wealth = hv271, se = se) %>%
  mutate(cv = 100 * se / abs(wealth))

ggplot(direct_reg, aes(x = reorder(region, wealth), y = wealth)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#1f77b4") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = wealth - 1.96 * se, ymax = wealth + 1.96 * se),
                width = 0.2, color = "#1f77b4", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title    = "Richesse moyenne par région avec IC 95%",
    subtitle = "Estimateur direct pondéré (svyby)",
    x = "Région", y = "Indice de richesse moyen"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
direct_reg %>% arrange(wealth) %>%
  select(region, wealth, se, cv) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Estimateurs directs par région")
```
